sourceCommitNote: These three files are byte-identical at this commit and at the steering repo local HEAD 691c3d4; git diff reports no change between them.
why: The owner chose to copy rather than move, so both repositories hold these. Two copies of one document is drift by default, so pnpm docs:check compares them and fails when they diverge.
comparison: Line endings are normalised (CRLF -> LF) on BOTH sides before comparing, because the steering repository has no .gitattributes and checks out CRLF on Windows. A LONE CR is NOT normalised: contentions.md contains one deliberately, inside a code span, as prose about this exact problem.
